analysis.summary: The investigation has identified a sustained brand impersonation campaign targeting CNC Intelligence Inc., a legitimate cryptocurrency investigation firm. The campaign operates by registering lookalike domains and using them for email-based social engineering, primarily targeting victims of prior cryptocurrency scams who are seeking recovery services. The campaign is connected to a broader recovery scam network that has been the subject of FBI law enforcement action.
analysis.evidence_quality: Investigation used 11 independent public sources including the target company's own report, DNS/WHOIS data, Reddit victim reports, independent scam trackers, and FBI press releases. Findings are strongly corroborated where multiple independent sources confirm the same conclusion.
key_relationships: cncintelinfo.com configured for ProtonMail email operations (E-005) — primary active threat
cncintelltd.com parked on SEDO after fraudulent use (E-008) — autonomous discovery
Connected to Payback LTD / Cyber-Forensics.net network (E-012, E-014)
FBI seized connected recovery scam websites (E-016)
gaps: No blockchain wallet addresses obtained — victims reported being asked to send crypto but addresses not publicly available
No access to email content — can only infer email-based phishing from DNS configuration
Historical DNS not available — cannot determine when domains moved to parking
Victim loss amounts not independently verified
additional_searches_recommended: Search dark web forums for wallet addresses associated with CNC Intelligence impersonators
Monitor cncintelinfo.com for future DNS changes (new A record, new MX)
Check certificate transparency logs for SSL certificates issued to these domains
Monitor ProtonMail abuse reports for cncintelinfo.com
Search court records for any civil litigation against these domains
analysis.confidence_assessment: HIGH confidence that this is a genuine brand impersonation campaign. MEDIUM confidence in the connection between individual domains and specific victims. The FBI seizure of connected entities provides strong law enforcement corroboration.

hypotheses: All 50+ domains are operated by the same group
cncintelinfo.com is actively sending phishing emails (inferred from DNS, not observed)
